title: Chesterton Windmill
scope: Warwickshire’s standing Chesterton Windmill, including its shallow stone platform, six open arches, upper stone drum, ribbed cap and four lattice sails.
limitations: The archived public-domain photos support the arcade, cap and sail silhouette. Small moulding and sail rail profiles and cap azimuth are approximate.
Scope includes the surviving mill and its shallow platform. The internal mechanism is outside this exterior model.
